title: Mid-Term Changes in Covered Openings, CareLine Service Plans
content:
The holder of a CareLine Service Plans plan may change the number of covered openings during a term, within the plan's maximum. Openings added above the base count are billed at the yearly extra-opening fee prorated over the full months left in the current plan year, as a plan fee charge on the change date. Removing openings mid-term refunds nothing; the lower count applies to the next renewal.

The base count, the maximum and the yearly extra-opening fee are the figures the product schedules set for the plan's tier; on every tier the mid-term charge is prorated over the full months remaining in the plan year.

### The charge in words

The charge for openings added mid-term equals the number of added openings that sit above the base count, multiplied by the yearly extra-opening fee, multiplied by the full months left in the current plan year and divided by the twelve months of a plan year. Added openings that stay within the base count carry no charge. The charge is billed as a plan fee charge dated the change date.

### Worked changes (hypothetical plan: base count 40, maximum 60, yearly extra-opening fee 4.00)

| Change | Full months left in the plan year | Openings added above the base count | Charge on the change date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 40 to 43 | 6 | 3 | 3 multiplied by 4.00, multiplied by 6 and divided by 12: 6.00 |
| 36 to 39 | 9 | 0 | None; the openings stay within the base count |
| 38 to 44 | 3 | 4 (openings 41 to 44) | 4 multiplied by 4.00, multiplied by 3 and divided by 12: 4.00 |
| 50 to 62 | — | — | Not available; 62 is above the maximum of 60 |

### Removals

| Change | Refund | Count used |
|---|---|---|
| 45 to 40, mid-term | None | The lower count of 40 applies to the next renewal |
